title: Pack manifest
description: The manifest.json of a stack pack in packs/<id>/. Packs are data loaded at runtime; the core knows no stack.

id.description: Pack identifier; it must match the directory name.

detect.description: Signs that a repository uses the stack. The pack applies when any of them matches.

items.description: One sign: a file matching path, which contains the text when contains is set.

path.description: Glob of a file or directory.

languages.description: Languages the pack reviews. Changed files in other languages are listed as not verified.

id.description: Language identifier, used by the lexer table and in work packages.

extensions.description: File name extensions, with the leading dot.

rules.description: Rules catalog file, relative to the pack directory.

lexer.description: Lexer table file, relative to the pack directory.

path.description: Checklist file, relative to the pack directory.

templates.description: Report and comment templates, relative to the pack directory.

noise.description: Globs of changed files listed as noise and not reviewed.

generatedMarkers.description: Texts that mark a file as generated when found in its first lines.

glob.description: Path glob with forward slashes: '*' matches within a segment, '**' matches any number of segments.

packId.description: Stack pack identifier, for example android or kotlin-multiplatform.

profile.description: Kind of repository, which selects the default criteria.

relativePath.description: Relative path with forward slashes, without empty, '.' or '..' segments.
